statements.t: The strategy is expected to deliver stable cash flows in the short to medium term through AVAX staking and Bitcoin Mining, while positioning the Company for substantial long-term value and broader ecosystem investments.
As treasury operations scale, the Company anticipates increased financial flexibility to pursue several value-enhancing initiatives.

Management remains confident that this integrated model of combining revenue producing assets with active ecosystem participation will differentiate AVAX One in the market and create enduring value for shareholders.
We continue to be a “smaller reporting company” and a non-accelerated filer and, as such, will continue to rely on the exemption outlined in (i) above for so long as we continue to qualify as such.

As a result of the foregoing, we believe a concentration exists as of the date of these financial statements, and a dissolution of the Avalanche Foundation or an inability of the Avalanche public blockchain network and/or AVAX tokens to function as expected, could result in near-term severe impacts to our business.
